content: It's not inherently "bad" to recognize you can't be a caregiver—that's self-awareness. But something hurtful might be: "I didn't sign up for this; figure it out yourself." Honest limits are healthy; dismissive abandonment causes lasting harm. Better to communicate boundaries with compassion and help find alternative care.
